paragraphs.text: Wryget was a Shadowmoor merrow , a skilled tideshaper, and a member of Sygg 's pirate crew.

He was spared by Jack Chierdagh when the kithkin attacked Sygg's crew. Later, he worked for Brigid Baeli . He helped to defend Mistmeadow and participated in the ambush of Ashling the Destroyer near Kinscaer . He survived the Maralen - Oona war, but his current whereabouts are unknown.
